data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, I'd generally recommend **Stripe** as the best all-round payment processor.

However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses, how much you sell, and whether you want to accept PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

Here are the main options I'd consider.

## Best payment processors compared

| Provider | Best for | Typical UK online fee |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Best overall | 1.5% + 20p |
| PayPal | Customer familiarity | 2.9% + fixed fee |
| Square | Simple online selling | 1.4% + 25p |
| Shopify Payments | Shopify stores | Depends on Shopify plan |
| GoCardless | Recurring payments | 1% + 20p |


*Indicative UK pricing, November 2026. Card type and international transactions can change the fees.* [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-online-payment-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whito.co.uk](https://whito.co.uk/tools/best-payment-processors-for-uk-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paypal.com](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business/paypal-business-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[stripe.com](https://stripe.com/gb/payments?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/online-payment-systems?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendations

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe – Best overall**

- Easy integration with most ecommerce platforms.
- Cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Subscriptions and recurring billing.
- No standard monthly processing fee.

My first choice for most independent online stores.

[Stripe website and pricing](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal – Best for customer familiarity**

- Many customers already have accounts.
- Customers can pay by card or PayPal.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.

[PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square – Best for simplicity**

- Straightforward setup.
- Payment links and online checkout.
- Particularly useful if you also sell face-to-face.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

## What I'd choose

For a typical small online shop, I'd start with\:

- **Stripe** as the main payment processor.
- **PayPal** as an additional payment option.

This gives customers flexibility without needing multiple complicated payment systems.

There are three things that would help me recommend the cheapest and most suitable option.

**1\. What platform is your online store built on?**
